problem.title: Minimum Number of Changes to Make Binary String Beautiful
problem.summary:
You are given a 0-indexed binary string `s` having an even length.
A string is beautiful if it's possible to partition it into one or more substrings such that:

• Each substring has an even length.

solution.approach: Analyzed problem constraints and identified optimal greedy/heap simulation strategy.
solution.verification_notes:
Example 1 Failed:
Input: s = "1001"
Expected: 2
Actual:   []
solution.hint: Think about whether a min-heap or two-pointer approach reduces the search space.
